end.parentNote: Asha practised the idea that people may have different languages, foods, festivals, and customs while sharing common feelings and goals. Riya connected this to Pongal, Lohri, Bihu, and classmates performing together at an annual day. No clear mix-up was recorded or corrected later. At home, ask Riya to give one new example of unity in diversity from daily life.
